Medical Image Analysis 2022 · MRI RECONSTRUCTION / SCORE-BASED DIFFUSION

加速 MRI 的分数扩散模型

Score-based diffusion models for accelerated MRI

Hyungjin Chung · Jong Chul Ye（通讯作者）

只用幅度图训练的连续时间去噪分数模型，训练完不需要为重建任务再改一行网络：推理时把反向 SDE 的一步与一次数据一致性投影交替执行，就能从欠采样的 k 空间重建复值图像，还能直接用到多线圈并行成像、给出后验样本并量化不确定性。

读之前，把这条链路分清

这一段是译者注，不是原文。它只做一件事：让你读到公式 (1)–(21) 时知道每个量在做什么。

  1. 前向 SDE 是「加噪」的定义：选一对漂移系数 f\boldsymbol{f}f 与扩散系数 ggg，就得到一族加噪过程；本文用 VE-SDE（方差爆炸），即 f=0\boldsymbol{f}=\boldsymbol{0}f=0、g=d[σ2(t)]/dtg=\sqrt{\mathrm{d}[\sigma^2(t)]/\mathrm{d}t}g=d[σ2(t)]/dt​，噪声尺度 σ(t)\sigma(t)σ(t) 从 0.010.010.01 几何增长到 378378378。
  2. 分数就是去噪方向：∇xlog⁡pt(x)\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}\log p_t(\boldsymbol{x})∇x​logpt​(x) 指向「密度更高」的方向。用去噪分数匹配训练一个网络 sθ(x,t)\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}(\boldsymbol{x},t)sθ​(x,t) 去逼近它，训练目标等价于「给定加噪图，预测所加的噪声」。
  3. 反向 SDE 是「采样」：从纯噪声出发，按反向 SDE 数值积分（预测步），就能落到数据分布的高密度区。每一步之后再插一次数据一致性投影 x←x+λA∗(y−Ax)\boldsymbol{x}\leftarrow\boldsymbol{x}+\lambda A^*(\boldsymbol{y}-A\boldsymbol{x})x←x+λA∗(y−Ax)，把采样拉回「与测量一致」的子空间——这就是本文的全部推理算法。
  4. 为什么能处理复值：网络只在幅度图上训练过，所以把复值图像的实部、虚部当成两张实值图分别跑同一套预测-校正，再拼回复数，最后按线圈做 SSOS 合并。
  5. 指标：PSNR（dB，越高越好）、SSIM（越高越好）；下游用 YOLOv5 在重建图上做病灶检测，报 mAP、precision、recall——用来衡量「重建把图像推离全采样分布有多远」。
术语速查（译者注）
k 空间
MRI 的原始测量空间，即图像的（二维）傅里叶系数空间。相位编码方向的「线」被跳过就是欠采样。
ACS 区域
k 空间中心的自校准信号区，本文的一维欠采样掩膜保留中心 4%（×8\times 8×8）或 8%（×4\times 4×4）的相位编码线。
VE-SDE / VP-SDE
方差爆炸 / 方差保持的随机微分方程；本文所有实验用 VE-SDE。
predictor / corrector
反向 SDE 的一步（预测）与朗之万动力学的一步（校正）；PC 采样交替执行二者。
数据一致性（DC）
把当前估计替换/校正到满足 y=Ax\boldsymbol{y}=A\boldsymbol{x}y=Ax 的方向上；本文用 λ∈[0,1]\lambda\in[0,1]λ∈[0,1] 的一次梯度步。
SSOS
sum-of-root-sum-of-squares：各线圈图像取模平方求和再开方，GRAPPA 类方法用它合并线圈。
非扩张映射
满足 ∥Tx−Tx′∥≤∥x−x′∥\|T\boldsymbol{x}-T\boldsymbol{x}'\|\le\|\boldsymbol{x}-\boldsymbol{x}'\|∥Tx−Tx′∥≤∥x−x′∥ 的算子；本文用它保证带数据一致性的迭代不会发散。
CCDF
come-closer-diffuse-faster：不从纯噪声、而从「前向加噪后的初始重建」出发，只跑最后一段反向过程来加速。

摘要

English original
Abstract

基于分数的扩散模型利用数据分布的梯度来建模图像，是一种强有力的方式。以学到的分数函数作为先验，本文引入一种从给定测量下的条件分布中采样的方法，使该模型可以直接用于求解成像中的逆问题，尤其是加速 MRI。简言之，我们用去噪分数匹配训练一个连续的时间相关分数函数；在推理阶段，我们在数值 SDE 求解器与数据一致性步骤之间迭代，从而完成重建。我们的模型训练时只需要幅度图像，却能够重建复值数据，甚至能扩展到并行成像。所提方法对欠采样模式不敏感，并具有优异的泛化能力，因此可用于任意采样方案、任意未参与训练的身体部位。此外，由于该方法是生成式的，它可以量化不确定性，而这是标准回归设定做不到的。在以上全部优势之上，我们的方法性能也非常强，甚至超过了用完全监督训练的模型。通过大量实验，我们验证了所提方法在质量与实用性上的优越性。代码见：此仓库。

English original
Score-based diffusion models provide a powerful way to model images using the gradient of the data distribution. Leveraging the learned score function as a prior, here we introduce a way to sample data from a conditional distribution given the measurements, such that the model can be readily used for solving inverse problems in imaging, especially for accelerated MRI. In short, we train a continuous time-dependent score function with denoising score matching. Then, at the inference stage, we iterate between the numerical SDE solver and data consistency step to achieve reconstruction. Our model requires magnitude images only for training, and yet is able to reconstruct complex-valued data, and even extends to parallel imaging. The proposed method is agnostic to sub-sampling patterns and has excellent generalization capability so that it can be used with any sampling schemes for any body parts that are not used for training data. Also, due to its generative nature, our approach can quantify uncertainty, which is not possible with standard regression settings. On top of all the advantages, our method also has very strong performance, even beating the models trained with full supervision. With extensive experiments, we verify the superiority of our method in terms of quality and practicality. Code available at: this repository.

关键词：基于分数的模型；扩散模型；逆问题；MRI。MSC[2021]：92C55、68U10、34A55。

English original
Keywords: Score-based models; Diffusion models; Inverse problems; MRI. MSC[2021] 92C55, 68U10, 34A55.

1 引言

English original
1 Introduction

多年来，从欠采样测量重建磁共振成像（MRI）的方法取得了大量进展。正则化重建方法利用手工设计的先验的稀疏性，配合数据一致性来得到解（Donoho, 2006），但先验的构造往往并不简单，而且没有一种先验能够正确建模 MRI 扫描真实的、复杂的数分布 pdatap_{\text{data}}pdata​。数据驱动的深度学习方法要么直接训练模型（Wang 等, 2016），要么间接训练（Oh 等, 2020）、（Yaman 等, 2020），但这些方法高度依赖对经过良好整理的大规模 kkk 空间数据库的监督，而这种数据库很难获得。

English original
Reconstruction methods from sub-sampled measurements for magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) have seen a lot of progress over the years. Regularized reconstruction methods exploit the sparsity of hand-crafted priors along with data consistency to arrive at a solution (Donoho, 2006), yet the construction of priors is often non-trivial, and none of them can properly model the actual complicated data distribution pdatap_{data}pdata​ of MRI scans. Data-driven deep learning methods train the models either directly (Wang et al., 2016) or indirectly (Oh et al., 2020; Yaman et al., 2020), yet the methods rely heavily on the supervision of a well-curated large database of kkk-space data, which is hard to obtain.

近来，基于分数的模型（Hyvärinen & Dayan, 2005）、（Song & Ermon, 2019）与去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）（Sohl-Dickstein 等, 2015）、（Ho 等, 2020）作为一类新的生成模型获得了广泛关注：它们不需要对抗训练就能达到惊人的高样本质量（Song 等, 2021b）、（Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021）、（Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021）。在众多工作中，Song 等（2021b）把离散的分数匹配过程推广到连续的随机微分方程（SDE），这实际上也把扩散模型纳入到同一个框架之中。下文我们把基于分数的 SDE 称为「基于分数的扩散模型」，以强调所提方法可以灵活地与这两类模型的任意具体实现配合使用：基于分数的生成模型，以及扩散模型。

English original
Recently, score-based models (Hyvärinen & Dayan, 2005; Song & Ermon, 2019), and denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) (Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015; Ho et al., 2020) have gained wide interest as a new class of generative model that achieves surprisingly high sample quality without adversarial training (Song et al., 2021b; Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021; Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021). Among many works, Song et al. (2021b) generalized discrete score-matching procedures to a continuous stochastic differential equation (SDE), which in fact also subsumes diffusion models into the same framework. We refer to score-based SDEs as score-based diffusion models henceforth to emphasize that our proposed methodology can be flexibly used with any realizations from the two model classes: score-based generative models, and diffusion models.

基于分数的扩散模型通过注入高斯噪声，按前向 SDE 扰动数据分布，最终到达一个可处理的分布（例如各向同性高斯分布）。为了从数据分布中采样，可以训练一个神经网络去估计对数数据分布的梯度（即分数函数 ∇xlog⁡p(x)\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}\log p(\boldsymbol{x})∇x​logp(x)），并用它数值求解反向 SDE。用这些基于分数的扩散模型从 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 做无条件生成，已经在图像（Song 等, 2021b）、（Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021）、（Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021）、音频（Kong 等, 2021）乃至图（Niu 等, 2020）合成中找到了应用。从 p(x∣y)p(\boldsymbol{x}|\boldsymbol{y})p(x∣y) 做条件生成也已经被研究过，在超分辨率（Saharia 等, 2021）、（Choi 等, 2021）、图像修补（Song & Ermon, 2019）、（Song 等, 2021b）、图像编辑（Meng 等, 2021）以及某些形式的医学图像重建（Ramzi 等, 2020）、（Song 等, 2022）中都得到了成功应用。

English original
Score-based diffusion models perturb the data distribution according to the forward SDE by injecting Gaussian noise, arriving at a tractable distribution (e.g. isotropic Gaussian distribution). In order to sample from the data distribution, one can train a neural network to estimate the gradient of the log data distribution (i.e. score function, ∇xlog⁡p(x)\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}\log p(\boldsymbol{x})∇x​logp(x)), and use it to solve the reverse SDE numerically. Unconditional generation of samples from p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) using these score-based diffusion models have found their applications in image (Song et al., 2021b; Nichol & Dhariwal, 2021; Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021), audio (Kong et al., 2021), and even graph (Niu et al., 2020) synthesis. Conditional generation from p(x∣y)p(\boldsymbol{x}|\boldsymbol{y})p(x∣y) has also been studied, achieving success in super-resolution (Saharia et al., 2021; Choi et al., 2021), inpainting (Song & Ermon, 2019; Song et al., 2021b), image editing (Meng et al., 2021), and some forms of medical image reconstruction (Ramzi et al., 2020; Song et al., 2022).

在本工作中，我们提出一个普遍适用于求解成像逆问题的框架，并特别聚焦于 MRI 重建任务。值得注意的是，我们的方法只需用幅度图像训练单个分数函数。用去噪分数匹配损失训练好分数模型之后，我们为方差爆炸（VE）-SDE（Song 等, 2021b）构造一个反向 SDE 求解器，使我们能够以测量 y\boldsymbol{y}y 为条件、从分布 p(x∣y)p(\boldsymbol{x}|\boldsymbol{y})p(x∣y) 中采样。具体做法是在每次迭代的无条件更新步之后施加一次数据一致性步。

English original
In this work, we propose a framework generally applicable to solving inverse problems in imaging and especially focus on the task of MRI reconstruction. Notably, our method requires training a single score function with magnitude images only. With the trained score model at hand using the de-noising score matching loss, we construct a solver for the reverse SDE from the variance exploding (VE)-SDE (Song et al., 2021b), which enables us to sample from the distribution p(x∣y)p(\boldsymbol{x}|\boldsymbol{y})p(x∣y), conditioned on the measurement y\boldsymbol{y}y. This is done by imposing data consistency step at every iteration, after the unconditional update step.

尽管分数函数并不是为求解图像重建任务而训练的，我们的方法仍取得了最先进的性能，甚至在复值图像上超过了专门为图像重建任务做过监督训练的模型。此外，与每设计一种新采样方案就必须重新训练的监督模型不同，我们的模型对加速过程中使用的欠采样模式不敏感。再者，所提方法可以扩展用于复值 MR 图像采集的重建，而用的只是一个从未见过复值数据的单一网络。更进一步，同一个分数函数可以很自然地用于实际的多线圈设定：基于分数函数的更新可以并行地施加到每张线圈图像上。值得一提的是，训练得到的分数函数泛化能力远超预期。事实上，当我们重建严重偏离训练分布的数据（例如不同对比度、甚至不同解剖部位）时，仍然能够得到高保真的重建。

English original
Despite the fact that the score function was not trained to solve the image reconstruction task, our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, even outperforming models that were trained in a supervised fashion specifically for image reconstruction tasks for complex images. Furthermore, our model is agnostic to the sub-sampling pattern used in the acceleration procedure, as opposed to supervised models which require re-training every time a new sampling scheme is designed. In addition, the proposed method can be extended to the reconstruction of complex-valued MR image acquisition using a single network that has never seen complex-valued data before. Even more, our method can be readily applied to practical multi-coil settings with the same score function, where the update via score function can be applied in parallel to each coil image. It is worth mentioning that the generalization capability of the trained score function is far greater. In fact, when we try the reconstruction of data that is heavily out of training data distribution (e.g. different contrast, and even different anatomy), we are still able to achieve high fidelity reconstruction.

最后，所提方法本质上是随机的，因此我们可以从同一个测量向量 y\boldsymbol{y}y 采样出多个重建结果。这一点尤其有用：我们无需对神经网络做任何特殊处理（例如 Monte Carlo dropout（Gal & Ghahramani, 2016）、直接估计方差（Kendall & Gal, 2017）），就能量化不确定性。我们观察到，在低加速因子下，后验样本之间的差异不大，说明网络具有很高的置信度。随着加速因子被推高，方差逐渐增大，这有可能帮助从业者做决策。

English original
Finally, the proposed method is inherently stochastic, and for that, we can sample multiple reconstruction results from the same measurement vector y\boldsymbol{y}y. This is especially useful since we are able to quantify uncertainty without any specific treatment (e.g. Monte Carlo dropout (Gal & Ghahramani, 2016), estimating variance directly (Kendall & Gal, 2017)) to the neural net. We observe that at low acceleration factors, posterior samples do not deviate much from each other, meaning high confidence of the network. As the acceleration factor is pushed to higher values, the variance gradually increases, which can potentially aid practitioners' decision-making.

鉴于这种惊人的泛化能力，以及产生不确定性图（uncertainty map）的灵活性，我们相信所提的基于分数的方法可以成为压缩感知 MRI 的重要框架。所提方法的概览见图 1，我们将在第 3 节详细展开。

English original
Given the amazing generalization capability and the flexibility to produce uncertainty maps, we believe that the proposed score-based approach can be an important framework for compressed sensing MRI. Overview of the proposed method is illustrated in Fig. 1, and we detail our proposed method in Section 3.

本文的组织结构如下：第 2 节回顾基于分数的扩散模型的相关背景；第 3 节给出所提方法的详细流程与算法；第 4 节说明实现与实验的具体设定；第 5 节展示实验结果；第 6 节讨论使用扩散模型做条件生成的同期工作、本工作的局限以及更广泛的影响；第 7 节总结全文。

English original
The manuscript is organized as follows: relevant background on score-based diffusion models is reviewed in Section 2; detailed procedure and algorithm of the proposed method is presented in Section 3; specifications about the implementation and experiments are given in Section 4; experimental results are featured in Section 5; discussion about the concurrent works of conditional generation using diffusion models, limitations, and broader impacts of our work is presented in Section 6; we conclude our work in Section 7.

where 0<β(t)<10<\beta(t)<10<β(t)<1 is a monotonically increasing function of noise scale, one achieves the variance preserving (VP)-SDE (Ho et al., 2020). In this case, the magnitude of the signal decays to 0, and the variance is preserved to a fixed constant as t→∞t\to\inftyt→∞. In fact, VP-SDE can be seen as the continuous version of DDPM (Song et al., 2021b; Kingma et al., 2021). Therefore, while DDPM was developed in a separate variational framework, it can also be seen as a realization of SDE.

where λ(t)\lambda(t)λ(t) is an appropriate weighting function, e.g. likelihood weighting of Song et al. (2021a), which puts different emphasis according to the time ttt. Intuitively, one can also understand (5) as training the neural network to de-noise x(t)\boldsymbol{x}(t)x(t), which was constructed by adding noise to x(0)\boldsymbol{x}(0)x(0).

在 Song & Ermon（2019）中，作者用一个生动的玩具例子说明：给随机变量加上高斯噪声，本质上得到的是原密度的一个模糊版本，这来自「两个随机变量之和对应两个密度的卷积」这一性质（Loève, 2017）。因此，当分数函数被训练成在多个噪声尺度上对给定数据去噪时，就可以从纯噪声开始扩散过程，并沿着数据密度的梯度信息逐渐降低噪声，最终到达数据分布的高密度模态。

English original
In Song & Ermon (2019), it was shown with an illustrative toy example that when you add Gaussian noise to the random variable, you essentially get a blurred version of the original density, which indeed comes from the property that the addition of two random variables corresponds to the convolution of two densities (Loève, 2017). Hence, when the score function is trained to denoise the given data across multiple noise scales, one can start the diffusion process with pure noise and gradually decrease the noise following the gradient information of the data density. Consequently, one can arrive at high-density modes of the data distribution.

译者注

ι\iotaι 是虚数单位。实部与虚部分别过同一个幅度图训练出来的分数网络，这是本文能「只用幅度图、却重建复值数据」的关键。

遗憾的是，这个算法只有在事先知道信号只含实值时才能使用；而且在 MRI 重建的大多数实际情形中，我们希望重建的信号是复值的，因此必须格外小心。这给用分数函数重建数据带来了一个问题，因为基于分数的 SDE 的原始理论（Song 等, 2021b）并没有考虑复值信号。

English original
Unfortunately, this algorithm can only be used when we know a priori that the signal only contains real values, and care must be taken since in most practical situations of MRI reconstruction, the signal that we would like to reconstruct is complex. This introduces a caveat when reconstructing the data with the score function because the original theory of score-based SDEs (Song et al., 2021b) did not consider complex signals.

一种可行的做法是训练一个能处理复值信号的分数函数，这在 Ramzi 等（2020）中被提出。在实现上，这相当于把信号的实部与虚部当作两个独立通道，对尺寸为 2×H×W2\times H\times W2×H×W 的图像施加去噪分数匹配目标，其中 HHH、WWW 分别是图像的高与宽。然而我们在实验中凭经验发现，这种处理会降低网络训练的稳定性，也会损害用算法 2 做重建的性能。我们进一步指出，这种处理限制了实用性，因为模型从此需要原始 kkk 空间数据来训练。

English original
One approach that is feasible is to train a score function so that it handles complex signals, was proposed in Ramzi et al. (2020). Implementation-wise, this corresponds to considering real and imaginary parts of the signal as separate channels and applying the de-noising score matching objective to handle 2×H×W2\times H\times W2×H×W sized image, where HHH and WWW are the height, and the width of the image, respectively. However, we empirically found that this treatment reduces the stability of network training, and also hurts the performance of the reconstruction using Algorithm 2. We further note that this treatment limits the practicality since the model now requires raw kkk-space data for training.

为克服这些限制，我们对算法 2 提出一个简单的修正，它给出一种用仅以幅度图训练出的分数函数 sθ\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}sθ​ 来重建复值图像的办法。该方法见算法 3：我们把图像拆成实部与虚部，对每一部分分别施加预测-校正步骤。于是，我们可以用同一个以幅度图训练出的分数函数，无缝地处理复值图像数据。这个简单的修正效果出奇地好，我们将在 5.2 节展示：用算法 3 重建复值线圈数据，甚至优于用显式监督训练的标准前馈神经网络。能够利用仅用幅度数据训练出的分数函数来重建复值数据，是一大优势，因为这样我们就可以只用 DICOM 数据训练神经网络。这一点之所以有利，是因为大量 MR 扫描以 DICOM 形式存在（Zbontar 等, 2018），而原始 kkk 空间数据通常因占用内存过大而被丢弃。

English original
To overcome these limitations, we propose a simple fix to Algorithm 2, which provides a way to use the score function sθ\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}sθ​ trained with magnitude images only, and use it to reconstruct complex images. The method is presented in Algorithm 3, where we split the image into real and imaginary parts, and apply the predictor-corrector step separately to each part. Accordingly, we can use the same score function that was trained with magnitude images to deal with complex image data in a seamless way. This simple fix works surprisingly well, and we show in Section 5.2 that reconstruction of complex-valued coil data with Algorithm 3 even outperforms the standard feed-forward neural network trained with explicit supervision. Being able to utilize score functions trained with magnitude-only data to reconstruct complex-valued data is a great advantage since we can use only the DICOM data to train the neural network. This is advantageous because the plethora of MR scans exist in the form of DICOM (Zbontar et al., 2018), while the raw kkk-space data are usually discarded due to their excessive memory size.

虽然所提的复值数据重建分数框架极其有用，但大多数现代 MRI 扫描仪（Zbontar 等, 2018）都有多个接收线圈，它们以不同的敏感度采集信号。自并行成像（PI）诞生以来（Deshmane 等, 2012），文献中已提出无数重建真实隐含信号的技术，其中最著名的两种是 SENSE（Pruessmann 等, 1999）与 GRAPPA（Griswold 等, 2002）。前者需要估计或标定线圈敏感度图，这些敏感度图被纳入 (7) 中给出的前向模型。相反，后者通过对每张已重建的线圈图像直接取模平方和再开方（SSOS）（Roemer 等, 1990），免去了对敏感度图的需要。由于实现简便等一系列优点，这种做法是临床实践中最广泛使用的方法之一。这里我们要说明，所提的基于分数的方法可以无缝地集成到 SSOS 型做法中。

English original
While the proposed score-based framework for the reconstruction of complex-valued data is extremely useful, most modern MRI scanners (Zbontar et al., 2018) have multiple receiver coils, which capture the signal with different sensitivities. Since the birth of PI (Deshmane et al., 2012), myriad of techniques to reconstruct the true latent signal have been proposed in the literature, two of the most prominent being SENSE (Pruessmann et al., 1999), and GRAPPA (Griswold et al., 2002). The former approach requires estimation or calibration of coil sensitivity maps, which are incorporated in the forward model specified in (7). Contrarily, the latter approach drops the need for the sensitivity maps, by simply taking the sum-of-root-sum-of-squares (SSOS) of each reconstructed coil image (Roemer et al., 1990). This approach is one of the most widely used methods in clinical practice due to several advantages including implementation ease. Here, we show that our score-based method can be integrated seamlessly into the SSOS-type approach.

具体而言，如算法 4 所介绍，我们的目标是逐线圈地重建数据。对 PI，为简洁起见我们把校正步数设为 1，即 M=1M=1M=1。更具体地说，与 GRAPPA 不同，我们不估计 GRAPPA 核，而是把算法 3 分别施加到每张线圈图像上，如图 2(a) 所示。值得注意的是，虽然我们的分数函数估计器 sθ(x,t)≃∇xtlog⁡p(x)\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}(\boldsymbol{x},t)\simeq\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}_t}\log p(\boldsymbol{x})sθ​(x,t)≃∇xt​​logp(x) 并未用单独的线圈图像训练，但独立线圈图像的分布与 p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x) 相差不大，因此把算法 3 施加到每张线圈图像上就能得到非常准确的重建。

English original
Specifically, as introduced in Algorithm 4, our objective is to reconstruct the data coil-by-coil. For PI, we set the number corrector step to one for brevity, i.e. M=1M=1M=1. More specifically, unlike GRAPPA, instead of estimating of the GRAPPA kernels, we simply apply Algorithm 3 separately to each coil image, as illustrated in Fig. 2 (a). Notably, although our score function estimator sθ(x,t)≃∇xtlog⁡p(x)\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}(\boldsymbol{x},t)\simeq\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}_t}\log p(\boldsymbol{x})sθ​(x,t)≃∇xt​​logp(x) were not trained with separate coil images, since the distribution of independent coil images does not deviate much from p(x)p(\boldsymbol{x})p(x), simply applying Algorithm 3 to each coil image induces a very accurate reconstruction.

算法 4 的一个缺点是各线圈重建之间没有相互交流。这可能是次优的，因为重建过程没有考虑到所有线圈图像都来自同一张图像。于是，为了正确利用不同线圈图像之间的相关性，我们另外在算法 5 中实现了一个混合型方法，把 SENSE 型约束纳入进来。具体来说，每经过 mmm 步的逐线圈更新，我们就用如下更新来强制线圈之间的依赖关系：

English original
One downside of Algorithm 4 is that there exists no cross-talk between the coil reconstructions. This may be suboptimal, because the reconstruction process does not take into account that all the coil images come from the same image. Instead, in order to properly leverage the correlation between different coil images, we additionally implement a hybrid-type method in Algorithm 5 by incorporating the SENSE type constraint. Specifically, for every mmm steps of individual coil updates, we coerce dependency between the coils with the following update:
公式 (16)
xi←xi+λA(mc)∗(y−A(mc)xi),\boldsymbol{x}_i \gets \boldsymbol{x}_i + \lambda A_{(mc)}^*(\boldsymbol{y} - A_{(mc)}\boldsymbol{x}_i),xi​←xi​+λA(mc)∗​(y−A(mc)​xi​),
A(mc)A_{(mc)}A(mc)​ 是 (8) 定义的多线圈前向测量矩阵。

其中 λ∈[0,1]\lambda\in[0,1]λ∈[0,1] 决定施加数据一致性的程度，A(mc)A_{(mc)}A(mc)​ 是 (8) 中定义的标准多线圈前向测量矩阵。这一步完成后，我们用 SSOS 操作得到最终结果。示意见图 2(b)。通过在迭代之间施加 (16) 的更新步、并让 λ\lambdaλ 随迭代线性递减，我们观察到性能提升、重建更锐利。

English original
where λ∈[0,1]\lambda\in[0,1]λ∈[0,1] decides the extent to which data consistency is imposed, and A(mc)A_{(mc)}A(mc)​ is the standard multi-coil forward measurement matrix as defined in (8). Once this is done, we arrive at the final result with SSOS operation. See Fig. 2 (b) for an illustration. By applying update steps of (16) in between with linearly decreasing the value of λ\lambdaλ as the iteration progresses, we observe improved performance and sharper reconstructions.

在不同的采样模式中，我们看到算法 5 一般在 1D 采样模式下表现更好，而算法 4 在 2D 模式下表现更好。因此，对 1D 欠采样我们报告算法 5 的重建结果，对 2D 欠采样我们报告算法 4 的结果。SSOS 型与混合型做法的一个注意点是推理速度慢。朴素地实现这些算法，会带来相当于单线圈重建 ccc 倍的计算时间。不过，这一点可以通过对各线圈数据并行计算而大大缓解，因为线程之间无需共享任何计算。在 GPU 资源充足的情况下，我们预计 PI 重建所需的计算时间可以降到与单线圈重建相当。

English original
Among the different sampling patterns, we see that Algorithm 5 generally performs better with 1D sampling patterns, whereas Algorithm 4 performs better with 2D patterns. Hence, we report on reconstructions with Algorithm 5 for 1D under-sampling, and Algorithm 4 for 2D under-sampling. One caveat for the SSOS-type, and hybrid-type approaches are the slow inference speed. Naively implementing the algorithms will induce ccc times longer computation time compared to the single-coil reconstruction. However, this can be much relieved by performing parallel computation with each coil data, since no computation needs to be shared across the threads. Given sufficient GPU resources, we expect that the computation time needed for PI reconstruction will be reduced down to the time needed for single-coil reconstruction.

4 方法

English original
4 Methods

4.1 实验数据

English original
4.1 Experimental data

主要实验（包括分数函数的训练）都在公开的 fastMRI 膝关节数据集（Zbontar 等, 2018）上完成[1]。我们以键 reconstruction_esc 给出的 320×320 目标幅度图像训练网络。需要说明的是，也可以从多线圈数据集的 reconstruction_rss 取同样的目标来训练分数函数，但我们没有发现明显的性能差异。

English original
The main experiments, including the training of the score function, were performed with fastMRI knee dataset (Zbontar et al., 2018), which is publicly available. We trained the network with 320 × 320 size target image magnitude, given as the key reconstruction_esc. We note that it is possible to train the score function with the same target from reconstruction_rss of the multi-coil dataset, but we found no significant difference in the performance.

在 973 个体数据（volume）的训练数据中，我们丢弃了每个体的头尾各五层切片，以避免用只有噪声的数据训练模型，最终得到约 25k 张训练切片。测试时，我们从验证集中随机抽取 30 个体，并丢弃每个体的头尾 5 层切片。并行成像实验中，受算力限制，我们只用了 10 个体。

English original
Among 973 volumes of training data, we dropped the first and last five slices from each volume, to avoid training the model with noise-only data. This results in approximately 25k slices of training data. For testing, we randomly sampled 30 volumes from the validation set, and dropped the first and last 5 slices from each volume. For PI experiments, we resorted to 10 volumes, due to the computational limitations.

我们按照 Song 等（2021b）建议的类似流程训练 VE-SDE。具体来说，我们用式 (5) 给出的目标训练网络，并设 λ(t)=σ2(t)\lambda(t)=\sigma^2(t)λ(t)=σ2(t)。注意这一具体的 λ(t)\lambda(t)λ(t) 选择使噪声尺度在 ttt 上保持稳定，理论上对应似然加权，这一点已在 Song 等（2021a）中证明。把该加权函数代入，我们就可用如下代价训练模型：

(5), with setting λ(t)=σ2(t)\lambda(t)=\sigma^2(t)λ(t)=σ2(t). Note that this specific choice of λ(t)\lambda(t)λ(t) stabilizes the noise scale across ttt, and theoretically corresponds to likelihood weighting, as proven in Song et al. (2021a). Plugging in the weighting function, we can train the model with the following cost:

where r=0.16r=0.16r=0.16 is set to a constant value. For noise variance schedule, we fix σmin=0.01, σmax=378\sigma_{min}=0.01,\ \sigma_{max}=378σmin​=0.01, σmax​=378, which is similar to what is advised in the technique of Song & Ermon (2020), then take the geometric series with the following form:

我们取批大小为 1，用 Adam 优化器（β1=0.9\beta_1=0.9β1​=0.9、β2=0.999\beta_2=0.999β2​=0.999）优化网络。前 5000 步优化使用线性预热调度，在第 5000 步达到 2e-4。我们施加最大值 1.0 的梯度裁剪（Arjovsky 等, 2017）。参数上施加率为 0.999 的指数滑动平均。优化进行 100 个 epoch，用单张 RTX 3090 GPU 训练分数函数约需 3 周。全部代码用 PyTorch 实现（Paszke 等, 2019）。

We take the batch size of 1, and optimize the network using the Adam optimizer (β1=0.9, β2=0.999\beta_1=0.9,\ \beta_2=0.999β1​=0.9, β2​=0.999). We use a linear warm-up schedule for the parameters for the first 5000 steps of optimization, reaching 2e-4 at the 5000-th step. We apply gradient clipping with the maximum value of 1.0 (Arjovsky et al., 2017). Exponential moving average with rate 0.999 is applied to the parameters. Optimization was performed for 100 epochs, and it took about 3 weeks of training the score function with a single RTX 3090 GPU. All code was implemented in PyTorch (Paszke et al., 2019).

对全部算法，除非另有说明，推理默认使用 N=2000N=2000N=2000、M=1M=1M=1 次迭代。对混合型算法 5，我们在第一次迭代时取 λ=1.0\lambda=1.0λ=1.0，并线性递减到最后一轮迭代的 λ=0.2\lambda=0.2λ=0.2。预测步与校正步各需要一次通过 sθ\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}sθ​ 的前向传播，在普通 GPU 上约需 150 ms。合计起来，实值图像的重建时间约 10 分钟，复值图像约 20 分钟。关于加速推理的方法以及未来研究的一些可能方向，我们在 6.1 节讨论。

English original
For all algorithms, we use N=2000, M=1N=2000,\ M=1N=2000, M=1 iterations for inference as default, unless specified otherwise. For the hybrid-type Algorithm 5, we start with λ=1.0\lambda=1.0λ=1.0 in the first iteration, and linearly decrease the value to λ=0.2\lambda=0.2λ=0.2 at the last iteration. Single forward-pass through sθ\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}sθ​ is required for both predictor and corrector steps, which takes about 150 ms with a commodity GPU. Summing up, this results in about 10 minutes of reconstruction time for real-valued images, and 20 minutes of reconstruction time for complex-valued images. We discuss ways for speeding up inference, and some potential directions for future studies in Section 6.1.

4.3 模型结构

English original
4.3 Model Architecture

我们以 ncsnpp 作为时间相关分数函数模型的实现基础[2]，这是 Song 等（2021b）建议的做法。该模型结构源自 U-Net（Ronneberger 等, 2015），构成 U-Net 的子模块取自 BigGAN 的残差块（Brock 等, 2019）。残差块中的跳连按 1/21/\sqrt{2}1/2​ 缩放（Karras 等, 2017）、（Karras 等, 2019）、（Karras 等, 2020）。池化与反池化采用 Zhang（2019）的反混叠池化。最终得到的 U-Net 有 4 个不同的尺度层级，每个层级有 4 个残差网络。用时间指标 ttt 对网络做条件化采用傅里叶特征（Tancik 等, 2020），条件特征被加到编码器特征上。更多细节见附录。

English original
We base the implementation of the time-dependent score function model ncsnpp as suggested in Song et al. (2021b). The model architecture stems from U-Net (Ronneberger et al., 2015), and the sub-block which consist U-Net are adopted from residual blocks of BigGAN (Brock et al., 2019). The skip connections in the residual blocks are scaled by 1/21/\sqrt{2}1/2​ as in (Karras et al., 2017; Karras et al., 2019; Karras et al., 2020). For pooling and unpooling, we adopt anti-aliasing pooling of Zhang (2019). The resulting U-Net has 4 different levels of scale, with 4 residual networks at each level. Conditioning of network with the time index ttt is performed with Fourier features (Tancik et al., 2020), where the conditional features are added to the encoder features. For further details, see Appendix.

4.4 对比研究

English original
4.4 Comparison study

为验证对现有标准方法的优越性，我们与 Zbontar 等（2018）中使用的基线方法做了对比研究。我们选择全变差（TV）重建（Block 等, 2007）作为压缩感知重建的代表方法，使用 sigpy.mri.app.TotalVariationRecon 中的实现[3]。我们对超参数 lambda 做网格搜索，只报告其中最好的结果。

English original
To verify superiority over the current standards, we perform comparison studies with baseline methods used in (Zbontar et al., 2018). We choose total variation (TV) reconstruction (Block et al., 2007) as the representative CS reconstruction method, where we use the implementation in sigpy.mri.app.TotalVariationRecon. We perform grid search on the hyper-parameter lambda, and report only the best results among them.

作为有代表性的深度学习方法，我们使用基于 U-Net 的监督学习重建（Zbontar 等, 2018）。虽然可以使用开源[4]的预训练模型，但为了取得更好的性能，我们重新实现了该模型。

English original
For a representative deep learning approach, we use supervised learning-based reconstruction using U-Net (Zbontar et al., 2018). While we could use the open-sourced pre-trained model, we re-implemented the model to achieve better performance.

我们还与最先进的监督方法做了比较。在实值仿真研究与单线圈实验中，我们与 DuDoRNet（Zhou & Zhou, 2020）比较，使用其官方实现[5]，4 个循环块与默认参数。我们沿用同样的质子密度（PD）/质子密度脂肪抑制（PDFS）图像作为先验信息。作为最先进的并行成像方法，我们使用端到端变分网络（E2E-varnet）（Sriram 等, 2020），它同时估计敏感度图。我们使用官方 fastMRI 代码库，按其在 fastMRI 膝关节数据集上建议的默认参数。对所有深度学习对比研究，我们都用高斯 1D 随机采样掩膜训练网络。

English original
We additionally compare against the state-of-the-art supervised methods. For the real-valued simulation study and single-coil experiment, we compare against DuDoRNet (Zhou & Zhou, 2020). We use the official implementation, with 4 recurrent blocks and default parameters. We resort to the same proton density (PD)/ proton density fat suppressed (PDFS) image for prior information. For state-of-the-art parallel imaging method, we use end-to-end variational network (E2E-varnet) (Sriram et al., 2020), which simultaneously estimates the sensitivity maps. We use the official fastMRI github with default parameters as advised with the fastMRI knee dataset. For all the deep learning comparison studies, we train the network with Gaussian 1D random sampling masks.

4.5 重建质量的度量

English original
4.5 Measurement of Reconstruction Quality

为量化重建结果与目标的接近程度，我们使用标准指标——峰值信噪比（PSNR）与结构相似性指数（SSIM）。我们进一步用 MedCalc 软件（Schoonjans 等, 1995）做重复测量方差分析（RM-ANOVA），检验差异的统计显著性。虽然这是社区最常用的两个指标，但众所周知，它们与放射科医生对图像质量的评分几乎对不上（Mason 等, 2019）。

English original
To quantify the proximity of the reconstructions to the target, we use the standard metrics - peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and structural similarity index (SSIM). We further test the statistical significance of the differences using repeated measures analysis of variance (RM-ANOVA) with the MedCalc software (Schoonjans et al., 1995). While these are the two most widely used metrics in the community, it is also well known that these metrics hardly line up with the radiologists' scoring on the image quality (Mason et al., 2019).

为完整刻画所提方法的优越性，我们着眼于这样一个事实：好的重建是那些能用于准确诊断的重建。如果重建质量与真值十分接近，下游任务的性能就不应退化——在我们的情形里，下游任务是诊断。为了与真值对比、比较每种重建的诊断能力，我们借助近期的 fastMRI+ 数据集（Zhao 等, 2021）。对 fastMRI 膝关节数据，fastMRI+ 标注给出了病理区域周围的边界框。我们用真值（全采样）图像训练一个标准的目标检测模型，再用该网络比较不同方法的重建在病灶检测上的表现。这样做，我们就能度量每种重建方法所造成的分布偏移程度。性能差异越小，我们就认为它与全采样数据的分布偏移越小。详细的实验流程见下一节（4.6 节）。我们从实验中量化目标检测文献中的三个标准指标——平均精度均值（mAP）、精确率（precision）与召回率（recall）。

English original
To fully capture the superiority of the proposed method, we focus on the fact that good reconstructions are the ones that can be used for accurate diagnosis. If the reconstruction quality closely matches the ground truth, there should be no degeneration in the performance of the downstream tasks - in our case diagnosis. In order to compare against ground truth, the diagnostic ability of each reconstruction, we leverage the recent fastMRI+ (Zhao et al., 2021) dataset. For fastMRI knee data, fastMRI+ annotations provide bounding boxes around the pathologic region. We train a standard object detection model using the ground truth (fully sampled) images and use this network to compare how well the model performs on pathology detection with reconstructions using different methods. By doing so, we can measure the amount of distribution shift that occurs with each reconstruction method. The less the difference in the performance, we conclude that there is less distribution shift from the fully-sampled data. For detailed experimental procedures, see the following section, i.e. Section 4.6. From the experiments, we quantify three standard metrics from the object detection literature - mean average precision (mAP), precision, and recall.

4.6 病灶检测

English original
4.6 Pathology Detection

目标检测模型我们使用最先进的 YOLO v5[6]。我们采用 YOLOv5m 的默认配置，这是一个中等规模的模型，在数据量不足时通常被建议作为基线模型。当尝试拟合更大版本的模型（即 YOLOv5l、YOLOv5x 等）时，我们发现会出现过拟合，性能小幅下降。

English original
For the object detection model, we use the state-of-the-art YOLO v5. We use the default configuration of YOLOv5m, which is a medium-sized model, often suggested as the baseline model when you do not have a sufficient amount of data. When trying to fit larger versions of the model, namely YOLOv5l, YOLOv5x, etc., we found that overfitting occurs and the performance drops by a small margin.

YOLOv5 模型的训练数据，我们使用 fastMRI+ 中所有带标注的训练数据，共 8053 张图像。训练集中不包含任何没有标注的图像。测试时，我们从验证集中随机选择 15 个病例。

English original
For training data of the YOLOv5 model, we use all the training data with annotations in fastMRI+, which consists of 8053 images in total. We do not include any images without annotations in the training set. For testing, we select 15 random cases out of the validation set.

模型权重从开源预训练模型微调而来，用批大小 16 训练 300 个 epoch。训练在 2×2080Ti GPU 上约需一天。

English original
Model weights were fine-tuned from the open-source pre-trained model, and were trained for 300 epochs using the batch size of 16. Training took about a day on 2×2080Ti2\times2080\mathrm{Ti}2×2080Ti GPU.

4.7 对不同解剖结构与对比度的泛化

English original
4.7 Generalization to different anatomy and contrast

可以观察到的一点是，所提方法以分数函数为主要工具，因而对分布偏移是稳健的。否则，算法 3、算法 4、算法 5 从一开始就不可能奏效，因为训练数据分布与推理数据分布并不相同。随之而来的疑问是：我们能把这种差异推到多远而仍然取得令人满意的结果？为进一步考察所提方法的泛化能力，我们用从不同解剖结构与对比度采集的数据做了大量实验。为获得最大的多样性，我们从多个开源数据库采集数据，包括 mridata（Flynn 等）、人类连接组计划（HCP）MRI 数据集（http://db.humanconnectome.org、http://github.com/hkaggarwal/modl）以及 MASSIVE[7]（http://massive-data.org/index.html）。实验中，所有数据都从全采样 kkk 空间做回顾性下采样。

English original
One observation that can be made is that the proposed method, which utilizes the score function as the main workhorse of the algorithm, is robust to distribution shifts. Otherwise, Algorithms 3, 4, 5 would not have worked in the first place, since the training data distribution and the inference data distribution are different. Subsequently, one might wonder how far we are able to push this discrepancy and still achieve satisfactory results. To further investigate the generalization capability of the proposed method, we ran extensive experiments with data collected from different anatomy and contrast. To achieve maximal diversity, we collected data from various open-source database, including mridata (Flynn et al.), human connectome project (HCP) MRI dataset (http://db.humanconnectome.org, http://github.com/hkaggarwal/modl, and MASSIVE (Multiple Acquisition for Standardization of Structural Imaging Validation and Evaluation) (http://massive-data.org/index.html). For experiments, all data were retrospectively down-sampled from the fully-sampled kkk-space.

5 结果

English original
5 Results

5.1 实值仿真研究

English original
5.1 Real-valued Simulation study

首先，我们在图 3 中给出使用 320×320 的 fastMRI 实值数据做回顾性欠采样的仿真研究结果。第一行是 2D ×8 高斯随机采样的重建，这是产生混叠伪影最少的欠采样模式。可以看到，所提方法几乎做到完美重建，即使在放大图像中也看不到任何结构差异。全变差（TV）重建会引入卡通状伪影，且无法去除整幅图像上弥漫的雾状伪影。U-Net 与 DuDoRNet 产生模糊的、次优的重建，这说明它们无法适应训练过程中未曾见过的不同采样模式。

English original
First, we show the results of the simulation study using retrospectively under-sampled fastMRI real-valued data of size 320 × 320 in Fig. 3. In the first row, we see reconstructions from 2D × 8 Gaussian random sampling, which is the sub-sampling pattern that induces the least aliasing artifact. Here, we see that the proposed performs nearly perfect reconstruction, where we see virtually no structural difference even in the zoomed-in image. Reconstruction through total variation (TV) induces cartoon-like artifacts, and cannot remove the overall foggy artifacts across the whole image. U-Net and DuDoRNet produce blurry reconstructions that are suboptimal, which indicates that they cannot adapt to different sampling patterns that were not seen from the training process.

第二行，我们比较用 ×4 均匀随机采样加速的重建，其中保留 4% 的相位编码线作为自校准信号（ACS）区域，产生中等程度的混叠伪影。即便在这一水平上，我们的方法仍能给出准确的重建，捕捉到真值的多数高频细节。在这个加速因子下，TV 无法完全去除混叠伪影。监督重建的平均化效应现在更明显，常常漏掉扫描中的重要细节。这一情形下 DuDoRNet 的重建也残留混叠伪影，尽管只是采样模式上的细微差别。

English original
In the second row, we compare the reconstructions from acceleration using × 4 uniform random sampling with 4% of the phase encoding lines kept as the autocalibrating signal (ACS) region, producing moderate aliasing artifacts. Even at this level, our method is able to provide accurate reconstruction, capturing most of the high-frequency details of the ground truth. In this acceleration factor, TV is not able to completely remove the aliasing artifacts. The averaging effect of supervised reconstruction now becomes more clear, often omitting the important details of the scan. Reconstruction with DuDoRNet also suffers from leftover aliasing artifacts in this regime, even though this is just a slight difference in the sampling pattern.

第三行展示 ×8 高斯随机采样（4% ACS 区域）。TV 只能部分去除伪影，同时引入相当多的卡通状伪影。监督 U-Net 与 DuDoRNet 抹平了大量细节，产生不真实的纹理。令人惊讶的是，即便在这个加速因子水平上，我们的方法仍能给出相当准确的重建，与真值的多数细节吻合。

English original
The third row shows × 8 Gaussian random sampling (4% ACS region). TV only partially removes the artifacts, while introducing quite an amount of cartoon-like artifacts. Supervised U-Net and DuDoRNet smooths away a lot of details, producing unrealistic texture. Surprisingly, even at this level of acceleration factor, our method provides a fairly accurate reconstruction, matching most of the details from the ground truth.

最后一行，我们看最激进的欠采样因子——×15 变密度泊松盘欠采样。得益于均匀散布的 kkk 空间采样点，在各种采样模式中该方案被认为是同类最优的方案之一，在相同「预算」下产生的伪影最少（Dwork 等, 2021）。这里与 2D 高斯采样所见到的情况类似，只有所提方法能给出高保真的图像重建。其它方法仍受严重伪影困扰，细节被模糊掉。

English original
In the last row, we see the most aggressive under-sampling factor - × 15 variable density poisson disk under-sampling. Thanks to the evenly spread out kkk-space samples, this sampling scheme is considered one of the state-of-the-art amongst the various sampling patterns, which produce the least artifacts given the same budjet (Dwork et al., 2021). Here, similar to what was seen with 2D Gaussian sampling, only the proposed method is able to produce high-fidelity image reconstruction. Other methods still suffer from severe artifacts, with blurred-out details.

我们在表 1 中给出测试集上定量指标的详尽比较。在所有不同的采样模式上，我们的方法都显著优于对比方法，并在高斯 1D 采样模式下与最先进的 DuDoRNet（Zhou & Zhou, 2020）相当。RM-ANOVA 的结果也表明，在大多数情形下所提方法的优越性相对所有其它方法都具有统计显著性。

English original
We provide a thorough comparison of quantitative metrics on the test set in Table 1. On all the different sampling patterns, our method significantly outperforms the comparison methods and is on par with the state-of-the-art DuDoRNet (Zhou & Zhou, 2020) in Gaussian 1D sampling pattern. Results of RM-ANOVA also indicates that the superiority of the proposed method is statistically significant against all other methods in most cases.

值得一提的是监督方法（即 U-Net、DuDoRNet）与所提方法在重建上的总体差异。我们观察到，随着加速因子被推高，用监督 U-Net 重建的结果变得更模糊。这是用 L1 损失、L2 损失等做监督训练的模型广为人知的效应（Ledig 等, 2017）。这种表现通常源自模型塌缩到分布的一个模态，而真实分布是高度多模态的。相反，我们的方法不显示这种效应，它在每个样本中访问高概率的各个模态。正因如此，我们的方法能够 1) 即使在高加速因子下也重建高频细节，2) 量化不确定性，正如我们在 5.5 节深入讨论的那样。

English original
It is worth mentioning the overall difference between the reconstructions through supervised methods (i.e., U-Net, DuDoRNet), and the proposed method. We observe that the reconstructions using supervised U-Net become blurrier as we push the acceleration factor to higher values. This is a widely known effect for models that are trained with supervision using L1 loss, L2 loss, etc (Ledig et al., 2017). Typically, this behavior stems from the models collapsing to a single mode of the distribution, whereas the actual distribution is highly multi-modal. On the contrary, our method does not show such an effect, visiting the modes of high probability in each sample. For that matter, our method is able to 1) reconstruct high-frequency details even at high acceleration factors, and 2) quantify uncertainty, as we discuss in-depth in Section 5.5

5.2 复值单线圈重建

English original
5.2 Complex-valued Single-coil Reconstruction

在图 4 中，我们展示所提方法（用算法 3）的重建结果以及基线对比。第一行是 ×8 2D 高斯随机采样加速。所提方法的重建非常准确，重建过程本身没有引入任何额外模糊。TV、监督 U-Net 与 DuDoRNet 在感知质量与定量指标上均远远落后于所提方法。

English original
In Fig. 4, we illustrate the reconstruction results of the proposed method using Algorithm 3, along with the baseline comparisons. In the first row, we have × 8 2D Gaussian random sampling acceleration. The proposed method performs a very accurate reconstruction, without inducing any additional blurriness from the reconstruction process. TV, supervised U-Net, and DuDoRNet fall largely behind the proposed method both in terms of perceptual quality and quantitative metrics.

第二行是 ×4 1D 高斯随机采样（8% ACS 区域）加速。同样，所提方法高精度地重建混叠图像，质量高于对比方法。

English original
In the second row, we have × 4 1D Gaussian random sampling (8% ACS region) acceleration. Again, the proposed method reconstructs the aliased image with high accuracy and has higher quality than the comparison methods.

第三行展示 ×8 1D 均匀随机采样（4% ACS 区域）。所提方法仍能在高频细节几乎不退化的情况下重建混叠图像。相反，监督 U-Net 的重建产生水平条状伪影，损害视觉质量。DuDoRNet 没有完全去除混叠伪影。TV 几乎给不出令人满意的结果。最后一行是 ×15 VD 泊松采样的重建。由于对 1D 采样模式的偏置，U-Net 与 DuDoRNet 都给出细节被冲淡的不满意结果。我们的方法能保留锐利边缘与纹理，清晰描绘解剖结构。表 1 中的定量指标同样印证了这种优越性。

English original
The third row shows × 8 1D uniform random sampling (4% ACS region). The proposed method is still able to reconstruct the aliased image with virtually no degradation in the high-frequency details. On the other hand, supervised U-Net reconstruction produces horizontal strip artifacts, hampering the visual quality. DuDoRNet does not remove the aliasing artifacts completely. TV hardly produces satisfactory results. The final row shows reconstructions with ×15 VD poisson sampling. Due to the bias toward 1D sampling patterns, both U-Net and DuDoRNet produce unsatisfactory results with washed-out details. Our method is able to preserve sharp edges and texture, clearly depicting the anatomical structure. Quantitative metrics in Table 1 also confirm the superiority.

如前所述，图 4 中展示的所有结果都是用同一个分数函数生成的，而该分数函数只用 DICOM 图像训练过。这意味着模型此前从未见过复值数据，但重建质量仍然出奇地高。这是我们的模型相对传统深度学习方法的一个重要优势。多数深度学习方法需要原始 kkk 空间数据来训练网络，而这很难做到，因为大多数原始数据在扫描之后就被丢弃（Zbontar 等, 2018）。相比之下，DICOM 图像收集起来相对容易得多，这使从业者能够收集大规模数据库用于训练。

English original
As mentioned earlier, all the results depicted in Fig. 4 were generated using the single score function, trained with DICOM images only. This means that the model has never seen complex-valued data before, and yet the quality of reconstruction is surprisingly high. This is an important advantage of our model over conventional DL methods. Most DL methods require raw kkk-space data to train the network, and this is hard to achieve since most raw data are discarded after the scan (Zbontar et al., 2018). In contrast, DICOM images are relatively much easier to collect, and this enables practitioners to collect a large database for training.

5.3 复值多线圈重建

English original
5.3 Complex-valued Multi-coil Reconstruction

我们在图 5 中比较 PI 重建的结果。与前面几节的结果一致，我们的方法显著优于其它方法，并且是唯一一种无论采样模式如何都能给出高保真重建的方法。这一点也可以从表 2 中看到：我们的方法在 1D 采样模式上与 SOTA 的 E2E-varnet 相当，而在 2D 采样模式上显著优于所有方法。

English original
We compare the results of PI reconstruction in Fig. 5. Consistent with the results from the prior sections, our method significantly outperforms other methods and is the only method that produces high fidelity reconstructions regardless of the sampling pattern. This can also be seen in Table 2, where we see that our method is on par with the SOTA E2E-varnet on 1D sampling patterns, while significantly outperforming all the methods in 2D sampling patterns.

在多线圈情形，深度学习方法对 1D 采样模式的偏置要大得多。这可以从 E2E-varnet 重建（图 5(d)）中看到的严重伪影看出来。我们推测，这是因为 E2E-varnet 的敏感度图估计模块在 2D 采样模式下彻底失效，导致水平条纹伪影。此外，尽管 U-Net 并不显式处理敏感度图，它对某些采样模式的偏置似乎比单线圈实验更大，重建中带有严重伪影。相反，我们的基于分数的方法对采样模式不敏感，在所有情形下都明显优于对比方法。

English original
The bias towards 1D sampling pattern for the deep-learning based method is much larger in the multi-coil case. This can be seen in the severe artifacts that can be seen in reconstructions via E2E-varnet (Fig. 5 (d)). We conjecture that this is because the sensitivity map estimation module of E2E-varnet fails dramatically with 2D sampling patterns, leading to horizontal streaking artifacts. Furthermore, although U-Net does not explicitly deal with sensitivity maps, the bias towards certain sampling patterns seems to be greater than in the single-coil experiments, showing reconstructions with heavy artifacts. On the other hand, our score-based method is agnostic to sampling patterns, clearly outperforming the comparison methods in all cases.

不过，在 PI 的情形下，我们确实观察到所提方法的一些潜在局限。即：由于我们对每个线圈考虑来自条件分布的随机样本，然后在最后一步对线圈图像取 SSOS 来形成重建，我们注意到相比单线圈重建会出现少量的平均化效应。尽管如此，我们要强调，我们的方法并未用多线圈数据训练，却仍能以最先进的性能重建 PI 数据。我们的方法可用于任意数量的线圈，无需标定敏感度图，从而可以对任何类型的扫描做实际应用。

English original
However, in the case of PI, we do observe some potential limitations of our method. Namely, since we consider stochastic samples from the conditional distribution for each coil, and then take the SSOS of the coil images at the last step to form the reconstruction, we recognize a small amount of averaging effect compared to single-coil reconstruction cases. Nevertheless, we emphasize that our method was not trained with multi-coil data, and is yet able to reconstruct PI data with state-of-the-art performance. Our method works with any arbitrary number of coils, without the need to calibrate sensitivity maps, thereby enabling a practical application to any type of scan.

5.4 病灶检测

English original
5.4 Pathology detection

病灶检测任务的整体结果见图 6，定量指标见图 7。图 6(a–d) 的图像分别由 ×4 1D 高斯随机欠采样（8% ACS 区域）重建得到，(e) 是用全采样数据得到的检测结果，(f) 是带对应标签的真值边界框。

English original
Overall results on the pathology detection task is illustrated in Fig. 6, and the quantitative metric is shown in Fig. 7. The images in Fig. 6 (a-d) were reconstructed from × 4 1D Gaussian random under-sampling (8% ACS region), (e) is the detection result using fully-sampled data, and (f) is the ground-truth bounding boxes along with the corresponding labels.

图 6(f) 第一行的患者扫描显示后交叉韧带（PCL）1 级扭伤。此外，在软骨的内侧与外侧都观察到部分厚度丧失/缺损。这在图 6(e) 中被准确捕捉：三个边界框全部被正确预测。用所提方法重建的结果与之非常接近，与全采样参考几乎没有差别（见图 6(c)）。用监督 U-Net 重建在这个下游任务上表现差得多，漏掉了软骨部分厚度丧失/缺损（图 6(b)）。DuDoRNet 的重建只检出其中一个软骨部分厚度丧失/缺损，同时错误地检出了半月板撕裂。如预期的那样，用 TV 重建做的诊断表现更差，在内侧/外侧都错误地预测了半月板撕裂。

English original
The patient scan in the first row of Fig. 6(f) shows grade 1 sprain on the posterior cruciate ligament (PCL). Moreover, both on the medial and the lateral side of the cartilage, partial-thickness loss/defect is observed. This is accurately captured in Fig. 6 (e), where all three bounding boxes are correctly predicted. Reconstruction with the proposed method come as close, with virtually no difference with the fully-sampled reference (see Fig. 6(c)). Reconstruction with supervised U-Net performs much worse on this downstream task, missing the cartilage partial thickness loss/defect (Fig. 6(b)). DuDoRNet reconstruction gets only one of the cartilage partial thickness loss/defect, while falsely detecting meniscus tears. As expected, diagnosis with TV reconstruction performs even worse, falsely predicting meniscus tear on both medial/lateral sides.

图 6(f) 第二行的患者扫描显示前交叉韧带（ACL）1 级扭伤。在全采样数据与所提方法的重建（分别为图 6(e) 与 (d)）上，模型都正确预测 ACL 低度扭伤，只是边界框大小有细微差别。两个模型也都错误地预测了半月板撕裂，考虑到模型并不完美，这似乎是合理的。相反，用监督 U-Net 的重建（图 6(b)）没有捕捉到 ACL 低度扭伤，只错误地估计了半月板撕裂。DuDoRNet 的结果与全采样数据相近，但在半月板撕裂的准确位置上混淆。图 6(a) 中的 TV 重建只错误地预测了软骨丧失/缺损，漏掉了真实的病灶。

English original
The patient scan in the second row of Fig. 6(f) show a grade 1 sprain on the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL). On both fully-sampled data, and reconstruction using the proposed method in Fig. 6(e),(d), respectively, the model correctly predicts ACL low-grade sprain, with small differences in the size of the bounding box. Both models also falsely predict meniscus tear, which seems reasonable given that the model is not perfect. Contrarily, reconstruction using supervised U-Net in Fig. 6(b) does not capture ACL low-grade sprain, and only falsely estimates meniscus tear. DuDoRNet comes similar to fully-sampled data, but is confused at the exact location of the meniscus tear. TV reconstruction in Fig. 6(a) only falsely predicts cartilage loss/defect, missing the true lesion.

从图 7 中的标准指标可以看到，使用全采样数据时 mAP 达到 0.754，这构成检测模型的上界。用所提方法的重建做检测，表现与之相当，有时甚至好于全采样参考。由于模型不完美、测试集规模也相对较小，这并不意味着所提方法优于全采样数据。但它确实意味着，用所提方法重建不会妨碍诊断能力，这在临床实践中很重要。相反，对比方法确实限制了诊断能力，因此在用于临床实践之前应当受到质疑。进一步的统计分析见附录。

English original
As can be seen from standard metrics in Fig. 7, the mAP metric using the fully-sampled data reaches 0.754, which serves as the upper bound for the detection model. Detection using the proposed reconstructions performs on par, or sometimes even better than the fully-sampled reference. Since the model is imperfect and the test dataset size is relatively small, this does not mean that the proposed method is better than the fully-sampled data. However, it does mean that reconstruction via the proposed method does not hamper the diagnostic capability, which is important in clinical practice. On the other hand, the comparison methods do limit the diagnostic capability, and thus should be questioned before usage in clinical practice. For further statistical analysis, see Appendix.

5.5 量化预测的不确定性

English original
5.5 Quantifying uncertainty of the prediction

我们的方法是一个生成式算法，有两个随机性来源。第一，样本从随机采样的向量 xN\boldsymbol{x}_NxN​ 出发。第二，预测步与校正步都包含采样随机噪声向量并把它们加到估计上。因此，所提算法的迭代过程通常会收敛到不同的结果。

English original
Our method is a generative algorithm, with two sources of stochasticity. First, the sample starts from a randomly sampled vector xN\boldsymbol{x}_NxN​. Second, both predictor and corrector steps involve sampling random noise vectors and adding them to the estimate. Therefore, the iterative procedure of the proposed algorithms typically converges to different outcomes.

由于这种生成性质，我们可以并行地跑多次重建，并量化预测的不确定性，如图 8 所示。这里，真值与混叠图像分别显示在图 8(a)、(b) 中。实验中我们取批大小 8，并行执行重建。重建的均值见图 8(c)，逐像素的标准差值见图 8(d)。在低加速因子（×2）下，我们看到不同重建之间的变化非常小。这说明模型置信度高，因此我们可以断定重建在图像各个部分都是准确的。随着加速因子增大、混叠伪影的程度变得更严重，我们看到不确定性在特定区域增大。这一不确定性度量有可能告知从业者应当在多大程度上信赖该重建，从而决定是否改用其它诊断工具。我们还在补充视频 1 中给出了各加速因子下的具体样本，而不是重建均值。

English original
Due to this generative nature, we can run multiple reconstructions in parallel, and quantify the uncertainty of the prediction, as depicted in Fig. 8. Here, the ground truth, and the aliased images are shown in Fig. 8 (a),(b), respectively. For the experiment, we take a batch size of 8, and run the reconstruction in parallel. The mean value of the reconstruction is shown in Fig. 8 (c), and the pixel-wise standard deviation values are shown in Fig. 8 (d). At low acceleration factors (×2), we see very little variation between the different reconstructions. This indicates high confidence of the model, and hence we can conclude that the reconstruction is exact in all parts of the image. As the acceleration factor is increased, and the degree of aliasing artifacts become more severe, we see that the uncertainty increase in specific regions. Potentially, this measure of uncertainty can inform the practitioners on how much they should rely on the reconstruction, thereby deciding whether to use a different diagnostic tool. We additionally provide specific realizations, rather than the mean of the reconstruction, at each acceleration factor in supplementary video 1.

5.6 重建分布外（OOD）数据

English original
5.6 Reconstruction out-of-distribution (OOD) data

在图 9 中，我们给出严重偏离分布的重建结果。注意我们的分数函数只学过质子密度（PD）/质子密度脂肪抑制（PDFS）冠状位膝关节扫描的分布。尽管如此，我们观察到用所提方法无论解剖结构与对比度如何都能得到高保真的重建。U-Net 与 DuDoRNet 等其它方法虽能在一定程度上泛化，但我们能清楚地看到残留的混叠伪影。相反，所提方法以最小的残差与锐利的对比度明显优于所有其它方法。我们最近发现，Jalal 等（2021）也独立地做出了这一观察，他们部分证明了后验采样对分布偏移确实高度稳健。这一性质在真实场景中确实非常有利，因为人们可以不管具体解剖结构与对比度，只用一个神经网络。更多不同解剖结构的实验结果，请见附录中的图 14 与图 15。

English original
In Fig. 9, we present reconstruction results, which are heavily out of distribution. Note that our score function has only learnt the distribution of proton density (PD) / proton density fat suppression (PDFS) coronal knee scans. Nevertheless, we observe that with the proposed method, we are able to achieve high fidelity reconstructions regardless of the anatomy and contrast. While other methods such as U-Net and DuDoRNet generalizes to a certain extent, we can clearly observe leftover aliasing artifacts. On the other hand, the proposed method clearly outperforms all the other methods with minimal residuals and sharp contrast. We recently found that this observation was also made independently in (Jalal et al., 2021), where the authors partially proved that posterior sampling is indeed highly robust to distribution shifts. This property is indeed very advantageous in real-world settings, since one may be able to use a single neural network regardless of the specific anatomy and contrast. For further experimental results of different anatomy, please see Fig. 14 and Fig. 15 in the Appendix.

6 讨论

English original
6 Discussions

6.1 加速推理

English original
6.1 Speeding up inference

用基于分数的扩散模型做图像重建，一个明显的局限是推理所需的时间。如 4.2 节所述，使用 N=2000N=2000N=2000 个离散化步需要约 10 分钟推理时间。加快推理的一种朴素做法是减少离散化步数，我们在图 10 中给出图像质量与步数之间的权衡。这里我们观察到，朴素地交错离散化步效果相当好，图像质量的让步很小。在低加速因子（例如 ×4）下尤其如此：只用 50 次迭代就能得到高度准确的重建。随着加速因子变得激进，我们的方法通常需要更多迭代才能达到最佳性能。不过从图中可以看到，性能在 N≈500N\approx 500N≈500 附近就饱和了。人们或许可以根据手头的加速程度，把它当作超参数在运行中调整。

English original
One obvious limitation of using score-based diffusion models for image reconstruction is the time required for inference. As stated in Section 4.2, it requires about 10 minutes of inference time for using N=2000N=2000N=2000 discretization steps. A naïve way for faster inference is to reduce the number of discretization steps, and we provide the trade-off between image quality vs. steps in Fig. 10. Here, we observe that naïvely interleaving the discretization steps work quite well, with minimal compromise in image quality. This is especially the case of low acceleration factors (e.g. ×4), where we achieve highly accurate reconstruction only with 50 iterations. As the acceleration factor gets aggressive, our method typically requires more iterations for maximal performance. However, from the figure, we see that the performance caps at about N=500N=500N=500. One could possibly adjust this as a hyperparameter on-the-fly, according to the degree of acceleration at hand.

也可以采用扩散模型求解逆问题的最先进加速策略，即 come-closer-diffuse-faster（CCDF），它最近在我们的姊妹工作（Chung 等, 2021）中被提出。具体来说，CCDF 指出不需要使用完整的反向扩散过程；相反，可以从一张经过前向扩散的、更好的初始化图像出发，只施加反向扩散，就能达到同等甚至更好的重建性能。由此得到的短时域显著加快了重建时间。该策略有基于随机收缩理论的严格证明作为支撑。感兴趣的读者可参阅 Chung 等（2021）。

English original
One can also employ the state-of-the-art acceleration strategy of diffusion models for inverse problems, called come-closer-diffuse-faster (CCDF), which was recently proposed in our companion work (Chung et al., 2021). Specifically, CCDF states that there is no need to use the full reverse diffusion procedure. Rather, one can start to apply reverse diffusion from a forward-diffused image from better an initialization to achieve reconstruction performance that is one par or better. The resulting short partial time horizon significantly accelerates the reconstruction time. The strategy is backed by rigorous proofs using the theory of stochastic contraction. Interested readers are referred to Chung et al. (2021).

6.2 用扩散模型做条件生成

English original
6.2 Conditional generation with diffusion models

基于分数的扩散模型现在是图像合成领域最流行的方法之一，其图像保真度可与最先进的 GAN 相比（Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021），并在多个数据集上取得最先进的对数似然（Kingma 等, 2021）、（Kim 等, 2021）。用这些模型做条件图像生成的兴趣也在上升。Song & Ermon（2019）最先提出用离散去噪分数匹配训练的分数模型做图像修补；这在 Song 等（2021b）中被进一步发展用于图像上色与类别条件的图像合成，用的是连续时间分数模型。同一团队发表了用 VE-SDE 做图像编辑的工作（Meng 等, 2021），其算法与 Song & Ermon（2019）、Song 等（2021b）中的图像修补类似。ILVR（Choi 等, 2021）把扩散模型（Ho 等, 2020）用于图像超分辨率与图像翻译。所有这些工作都需要训练一个与实际目标任务无关的分数模型，因而很灵活。然而，此前所有工作都聚焦于条件也留在图像域内的应用，这使问题更容易求解。我们的方法进一步增加了灵活性，说明条件可以施加在不必与图像同域的测量域上。

English original
Score-based diffusion models are now one of the most popular methods in the context of image synthesis, matching the image fidelity of state-of-the-art GANs (Dhariwal & Nichol, 2021), and achieving the state-of-the-art log-likelihood on various datasets (Kingma et al., 2021; Kim et al., 2021). The interest in using these models for conditional image generation is also rising. Song & Ermon (2019) first proposed to use score models trained with discrete de-noising score matching for image inpainting. This was further developed in Song et al. (2021b) for image colorization, and class-conditional image synthesis, using continuous-time score models. The same group published a work for image editing (Meng et al., 2021) using VE-SDEs, which uses a similar algorithm to image inpainting used in Song & Ermon, 2019; Song et al., 2021b). ILVR (Choi et al., 2021) adopts diffusion models (Ho et al., 2020) for image super-resolution and image translation. All these works require training of a score model irrelevant to the actual objective task, and are thus flexible. Nevertheless, all the prior works have focused on applications where the condition also stays in the image domain, which makes the problem easier to solve. Our method adds further flexibility by showing that conditions can be applied in measurement domains that are not necessarily in the same image domain.

我们知道有一项先前工作把去噪分数匹配用于 MRI 重建（Ramzi 等, 2020）。Ramzi 等（2020）的作者用摊销残差去噪自编码器（AR-DAE）分数匹配损失（Lim 等, 2020）训练分数函数，然后用退火哈密顿 MC（Neal, 2011）从测量做重建。然而，Ramzi 等（2020）报告他们的方法大幅落后于监督学习方法，尤其是在考虑单样本时。此外，Ramzi 等（2020）的训练方法针对分离通道的复值数据，这限制了其应用。相反，我们的方法胜过用监督训练的神经网络，而且训练只需幅度图像。同样值得注意的是，所提方法适用于 PI。

English original
We are aware of one prior work which used denoising score matching for MRI reconstruction (Ramzi et al., 2020). The authors of Ramzi et al. (2020) use amortized residual de-noising autoencoder (AR-DAE) score matching loss (Lim et al., 2020) to train the score function, then uses annealed Hamiltonian MC (Neal, 2011) to perform reconstruction from measurement. However, Ramzi et al. (2020) reported that their method falls behind supervised learning approaches by a large margin, especially when considering single samples. Moreover, the training methodology in Ramzi et al. (2020) targets separate channel complex-valued data, which limits their application. Our method, on the other hand, beats neural networks trained with supervision, and requires only the magnitude images for training. It is also notable that the proposed method is applicable to PI.

本文投稿之后，我们发现了两项与所提工作密切相关的独立工作。Jalal 等（2021）提出用基于分数的生成模型训练一个与我们类似的分数函数，并通过把退火朗之万动力学（ALD）（Song & Ermon, 2019）与（在假设高斯测量噪声下）关于数据保真项的梯度信息结合起来进行采样。正如我们的工作所示，Jalal 等（2021）也展示了用基于分数的生成模型做重建在不同欠采样模式与多样解剖结构上的稳健性。我们与 Jalal 等（2021）最大的差别在于：我们的方法训练分数函数只需要 DICOM 图像，这与 Jalal 等（2021）形成鲜明对比，因为他们需要全采样 kkk 空间数据来训练分数函数。此外，我们的工作基于分数匹配的连续版本（Song 等, 2021b），而 Jalal 等（2021）的工作基于离散版本（Song & Ermon, 2020）。同样值得一提的是，我们使用了更先进的采样器（PC）与更高效的网络结构，后者已被证明能大幅提升生成建模的性能（Song 等, 2021b）。最后，Jalal 等（2021）引入了对数据保真梯度项的退火，这需要为每个噪声尺度指定方差调度。我们的方法没有额外的超参数，因而更容易实现。

English original
After the submission of this paper, we found two independent works that are closely related to the proposed work. Jalal et al. (2021) proposes to use score-based generative models to train a score function that is similar to ours, and sample by taking annealed Langevin dynamics (ALD) (Song & Ermon, 2019) together with the gradient information with respect to the data fidelity term by assuming Gaussian measurement noise. As was also shown in our work, Jalal et al. (2021) illustrates the robustness of using a score-based generative model for reconstruction over different sub-sampling patterns and diverse anatomy. The largest difference between us and Jalal et al. (2021) comes from the fact that our method only requires DICOM images for training the score function. This is in stark contrast with Jalal et al. (2021), as they require fully-sampled kkk-space data for training the score function. Furthermore, our work is based on the continuous version of score matching (Song et al., 2021b), whereas the work of Jalal et al. (2021) is based on a discrete version (Song & Ermon, 2020). It is also worth mentioning that we use an advanced sampler (PC), and a more efficient network architecture, which was shown to improve the performance of generative modeling by a large margin (Song et al., 2021b). Finally, Jalal et al. (2021) introduces annealing the data fidelity gradient terms which require specifying the variance schedule per each noise scale. Our method does not have additional hyper-parameters, and is hence easier to implement.

Song 等（2022）也许与我们的工作关系最密切：作者也提出使用 Song 等（2021b）的 VE-SDE，并使用与我们相同的网络结构和 PC 采样器。我们的工作与 Song 等（2022）的关键差别在于：我们推导出的求解器能够重建复值数据，也能重建多线圈数据。Song 等（2022）只关注从实值图像出发的仿真重建，这限制了实用性。此外，他们施加数据保真项的方式与我们的工作略有不同。

English original
Song et al. (2022) is perhaps the most related to our work, in that the authors also propose to use VE-SDE of Song et al. (2021b), and they use the same network architecture together with the PC sampler, as in our work. The crucial difference of our work from Song et al. (2022) is that we derive solvers that are capable of reconstructing complex-valued data, and also multi-coil data. Song et al. (2022) only focused on solving simulated reconstructions from real-valued images, which limits the practicality. Moreover, the data fidelity imposing step differs slightly from our work.

6.3 能量模型

English original
6.3 Energy based models

能量模型（EBM）是未归一化的概率模型，其优点是免去计算归一化常数（即配分函数）的需要（Song & Kingma, 2021）。我们的工作依赖去噪分数匹配来估计分数，这也属于 EBM 的范畴。当然，训练 EBM 还有其它方式，除分数匹配之外最广为人知的一种是对比散度（CD）（Carreira-Perpinan & Hinton, 2005）。

English original
Energy-based models (EBMs) are non-normalized probabilistic models, which have the advantage of circumventing the need to compute the normalizing constant (i.e. the partition function) (Song & Kingma, 2021). Our work relies on denoising score matching to estimate the score, which also belongs to the category of EBMs. There are, of course, other ways to train EBMs, and one of the most widely known methods other than score matching, is contrastive divergence (CD) (Carreira-Perpinan & Hinton, 2005).

与我们的工作同期，有人提出了一种利用 CD 的 MR 加速算法（Guan 等, 2021）。该工作把方法建立在用持续对比散度（PCD）训练的 EBM 之上，PCD 是使用样本缓冲区的 CD 变体（Du & Mordatch, 2019）。具体来说，训练一个参数化的能量函数 Eθ(⋅)E_\theta(\cdot)Eθ​(⋅)，使其在输入很可能属于数据分布时取低值、否则取高值。能量函数训练完成后，就可以通过 MCMC 生成无条件样本，或在 MCMC 更新步之间施加数据一致性投影，从而从条件分布采样。

English original
Concurrent to our work, an MR acceleration algorithm utilizing CD was proposed (Guan et al., 2021). This work grounds their method on an EBM, trained with persistent contrastive divergence (PCD), which is a variant of CD using sample buffers (Du & Mordatch, 2019). Specifically, a parameterized energy function Eθ(⋅)E_\theta(\cdot)Eθ​(⋅) is trained such that it takes low values when the input to the function is likely to be in the data distribution, and high values when this is not the case. Once the energy function is trained, one can generate unconditional samples via MCMC, or apply data consistency projection in between the MCMC update steps to sample from a conditional distribution.

这一过程实际上与我们的方法相似，训练出的函数之间存在关系 ∇xlog⁡pθ(x)=−∇xEθ(x)\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}\log p_\theta(\boldsymbol{x})=-\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}E_\theta(\boldsymbol{x})∇x​logpθ​(x)=−∇x​Eθ​(x)。不过，我们注意到所提方法与 Guan 等（2021）之间有两个关键差别。第一，为用 CD 训练 EθE_\thetaEθ​，必须在每次训练迭代时用 MCMC 产生负样本，这既不容易也很昂贵，需要应用若干启发式技巧才能让算法工作。相反，我们的分数函数训练直接得多、也更稳健，可以归结为损失函数的一个显式形式，如式 (17) 所表述。第二，我们的方法训练只需幅度（DICOM）图像，而 Guan 等（2021）需要原始数据。

English original
This procedure is in fact similar to our method, with the trained functions forming the relationship of ∇xlog⁡pθ(x)=−∇xEθ(x)\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}\log p_\theta(\boldsymbol{x})=-\nabla_{\boldsymbol{x}}E_\theta(\boldsymbol{x})∇x​logpθ​(x)=−∇x​Eθ​(x). However, we note two key differences of the proposed method from Guan et al. (2021). First, in order to train EθE_\thetaEθ​ with CD, one has to produce negative samples with MCMC at every iteration of training, which is non-trivial and costly. Several heuristics need to be applied to make the algorithm work. In contrast, the training of our score function is much more straightforward and robust, breaking down to an explicit form of the loss function, as formulated in Eq. (17). Second, our method only requires magnitude (DICOM) images for training, whereas Guan et al. (2021) requires raw data.

6.4 求解逆问题的生成模型

English original
6.4 Generative models for inverse problems

在扩散模型近期的兴起之前，已有若干做法把生成模型（尤其是生成对抗网络（GAN）（Goodfellow 等, 2014））用作求解逆问题的先验（Marinescu 等, 2021）、（Asim 等, 2020）。这些方法相比针对特定问题训练的监督模型更具灵活性：人们可以利用一个在不知道前向物理的情况下训练好的生成器 GφG_\varphiGφ​。本质上，要用 GAN 先验求解逆问题，通常会优化下式：

English original
Before the recent surge of diffusion models, there have been several approaches to use generative models, especially generative adversarial networks (GAN) (Goodfellow et al., 2014) as priors for solving inverse problems (Marinescu et al., 2021; Asim et al., 2020). These methods offer improved flexibility over supervised models which are trained for specific problems. Rather, one can leverage a well-trained generator GφG_\varphiGφ​, which was trained without the knowledge of the forward physics. In essence, in order to solve inverse problems with GAN prior, one would typically optimize for the following:
公式 (20)
min⁡z∥AGφ(z)−y∥,\min_{\boldsymbol{z}} \|AG_\varphi(\boldsymbol{z}) - \boldsymbol{y}\|,zmin​∥AGφ​(z)−y∥,

其中 AAA 与 y\boldsymbol{y}y 如式 (7) 所定义，z\boldsymbol{z}z 表示隐（噪声）向量。这对应于寻找使数据保真最小的正确隐向量 z\boldsymbol{z}z。也可以尝试

English original
where AAA and y\boldsymbol{y}y are as defined in eq. (7), and z\boldsymbol{z}z denotes the latent (noise) vector. This corresponds to finding the correct latent vector z\boldsymbol{z}z which minimizes the data fidelity. One can also try
公式 (21)
min⁡φ∥AGφ(z)−y∥,\min_{\varphi} \|AG_\varphi(\boldsymbol{z}) - \boldsymbol{y}\|,φmin​∥AGφ​(z)−y∥,

这对应于调整模型参数 φ\varphiφ，使生成器适配问题的前向物理。一旦通过 (20) 或 (21) 完成优化，只需一次通过生成器 GφG_\varphiGφ​ 的前向传播即可重建。遗憾的是，这些方法存在几个问题。

English original
which corresponds to tweaking the model parameters φ\varphiφ so that the generator adapts to the forward physics of the problem. Once the optimization via (20) or (21) is complete, a single forward pass through the generator GφG_\varphiGφ​ is sufficient for reconstruction. Unfortunately, there are several problems with these methods.

第一，问题 (20) 与 (21) 都不容易求解，需要使用复杂的损失函数（Marinescu 等, 2021）、（Asim 等, 2020）等若干启发式技巧。考虑到 GAN 本身也以难以训练著称，依赖 GAN 先验的方法相对难以复现。第二，最后的重建步骤是对 GφG_\varphiGφ​ 的单次前向传播。对高度病态的问题，单次传播可能特别难以生成高质量样本，这或许正是难以同时取得高质量与高数据保真重建的原因之一。

English original
First, both the problems (20) and (21) are nontrivial to solve, and require several heuristics such as using a sophisticated loss function (Marinescu et al., 2021; Asim et al., 2020). Considering that GANs themselves are also notoriously hard to train, methods that rely on GAN priors are relatively hard to reproduce. Second, the final reconstruction step involves a single forward pass through GφG_\varphiGφ​. For highly ill-posed problems, it could be particularly hard to generate high-quality samples from this single pass, which could be a reason why it is hard to achieve a reconstruction with both high quality and data fidelity.

所提方法提出用扩散模型替代 GAN，同时解决了这两个问题。扩散模型有相对明确的损失，因而更容易训练。此外，采样过程可以很方便地用求解逆问题最基本的方法完成。更进一步，借助扩散模型，由于我们迭代地精化重建，因而可以实现细粒度的控制。

English original
The proposed method, which proposes to use diffusion models instead of GANs, solves both problems. Diffusion models have a relatively well-defined loss and are thus easier to train. Moreover, the sampling procedure can easily be done with the most basic method of solving inverse problems. Further, with diffusion models, one can achieve fine-grained control since we iteratively refine our reconstruction.

6.5 更广泛的影响

English original
6.5 Broader Impact

在训练好的分数函数与对推理流程做恰当修改的前提下，所提方法可以很容易地用于计算成像中的其它问题。单个分数函数已经展示出广泛的适用性：超分辨率（Choi 等, 2021）、（Saharia 等, 2021）、图像重建等等。这有可能改变当前生物医学成像中深度学习的范式。例如，只要容量足够，人们可以为一个成像模态训练单个分数函数，并把它当作通用的问题求解器。

English original
The proposed method can be readily applied to other problems in computational imaging, with well trained score function and the right modifications to the inference procedure. A single score function has already shown broad applicability: SR (Choi et al., 2021; Saharia et al., 2021), image reconstruction, and others. This could potentially shift the current paradigm of deep learning in biomedical imaging. For example, one can train a single score function for the imaging modality, and use it as a universal problem solver, given enough capacity.

6.6 局限

English original
6.6 Limitations

为完整起见，这里列出当前工作的两点局限。第一，当我们尝试用 1D 欠采样模式重建 OOD 数据时，偶尔会在局部边缘观察到轻微的、类混叠的伪影。如图 11（1. OOD 重建）所示，该伪影并不显著。但在把所提框架推广到 OOD 数据时应加小心，因为稳健性会打折扣。我们注意到，在 2D 采样模式（如图 9 所示）下并未观察到此类伪影。

English original
For completeness, here we list two limitations of the current work. First, when we attempt to reconstruct OOD data with 1D under-sampling pattern, we sometimes observe mild aliasing-like artifacts in local edges. As illustrated in Fig. 11 (1. OOD recon), the artifact is not significant. However, care should be taken when extending the proposed framework to OOD data, as the robustness will be compromised. We note that such an artifact is not observed in 2D sampling patterns, as was shown in Fig. 9.

第二，当追求极端条件下的重建时（如图 11 的 2. 极端重建），我们偶尔会得到不满意的结果（例如红色虚线标出的样本）。此外我们观察到，由于高度病态，细节结构在后验样本之间具有高方差。因此，在把加速因子推到很高时应加小心，例如像 5.5 节所讨论的那样采样多个重建并考虑其不确定性。

English original
Second, when pursuing extreme-condition reconstruction, as in Fig. 11 (2. Extreme recon), we occasionally acquire results that are unsatisfactory (e.g. sample marked with the red dotted line). Moreover, we observe that the detailed structure has high variance within the posterior samples, due to the high ill-posedness. Hence, care should be taken when pushing the accelerating factor to very high values, by, for example, sampling multiple reconstructions and considering the uncertainty as was discussed in section 5.5.

7 结论

English original
7 Conclusion

总之，我们提出了一种用于加速 MRI 的、新的基于分数的重建方法。我们用幅度数据，通过连续时间去噪分数匹配训练对数数据分布的梯度。以学到的分数为先验，只需在每一步施加数据一致性投影，就能从给定测量下的条件分布中采样。无论是单线圈还是多线圈情形，我们的方法都能给出高精度的重建。与先前工作相比，我们在质量与实用性两方面都展示了所提方法的优越性。

English original
In conclusion, we propose a novel score-based reconstruction method for accelerated MRI. We train the gradient of the log data distribution with continuous-time denoising score matching using the magnitude data. Using the learned score as the prior, one can sample from the conditional distribution given the measurement by simply applying data consistency projection at every step. Our method produces reconstructions of high accuracy, whether it be single-coil, or multi-coil cases. Compared to prior arts, we show the superiority of our method both in terms of quality, and practicality.

我们相信，我们的方法为成像中的逆问题开启了一代新方法。把我们的方法直接应用到其它场景以检验其一般性，是一个有趣的未来研究方向。除此之外，还有一些未解的问题，例如缩小我们的方法与前馈神经网络方法之间的重建速度差距。我们预期，未来不久会有许多有趣的问题与答案被热烈讨论。

English original
We believe that our method opens up a new generation of methods for inverse problems in imaging. Direct application of our method to other venues to test the generality is an interesting direction of future research. Other than that, there still remain unanswered questions, for example, reducing the reconstruction speed gap between our method and feedforward neural network approaches. We expect that many interesting questions and answers will be actively discussed in the near future.

附录 A 网络结构细节

English original
Appendix: Details of network architecture

本节详细说明用于构造分数函数 sθs_\thetasθ​ 的 ncsnpp 网络结构，尤其聚焦网络纳入时间条件的方式。结构的整体示意见图 12。网络以 xt\boldsymbol{x}_txt​ 与 ttt 为输入。注意，由于我们求解的是连续 SDE，额外的时间条件变量很重要。时间条件 ttt 通过图 12(c) 所示的时间条件模块，利用 Tancik 等（2020）引入的傅里叶特征。在图中，这被表示为高斯傅里叶投影（GFP）模块，可以数学地写成：

English original
In this section, we elaborate on the ncsnpp network architecture used for constructing the score function sθ\boldsymbol{s}_{\boldsymbol{\theta}}sθ​, especially focusing on the way the network incorporates time conditions. Overall illustration of the architecture is depicted in Fig. 12. The network takes in as input, xt\boldsymbol{x}_txt​, and ttt. Note that since we are solving for a continuous SDE, the additional time conditioning variable is important. For the time condition ttt, it passes through the time conditioning module, as shown in Fig. 12 (c), utilizing the Fourier features introduced in Tancik et al. (2020). In the figure, this is given as the Gaussian Fourier Projection (GFP) module, which can be mathematically written with:
公式（原文未编号）
GFP(a):=[sin⁡(2πw1a),sin⁡(2πw2a),…,sin⁡(2πwda),cos⁡(2πw1a),cos⁡(2πw2a),…cos⁡(2πwda)],\begin{aligned}\text{GFP}(a) := &[\sin(2\pi w_1 a), \sin(2\pi w_2 a), \dots, \sin(2\pi w_d a), \\ &\cos(2\pi w_1 a), \cos(2\pi w_2 a), \dots \cos(2\pi w_d a)],\end{aligned}GFP(a):=​[sin(2πw1​a),sin(2πw2​a),…,sin(2πwd​a),cos(2πw1​a),cos(2πw2​a),…cos(2πwd​a)],​

其中权重 w1,w2,…,wdw_1,w_2,\dots,w_dw1​,w2​,…,wd​ 是不可训练的随机初始化网络参数，用 torch.randn(d) * scale 初始化，我们把 scale 设为 16。随后，嵌入向量通过几层 MLP，使尺寸与输入图像特征的通道维匹配。最后，时间特征向量在 H,WH,WH,W 维上广播，通过各层级的残差块加到图像特征上。

English original
where the weights w1,w2,…,wdw_1,w_2,\dots,w_dw1​,w2​,…,wd​ are non-trainable random initialized network parameters that are initialized with torch.randn(d) * scale, and we set scale to be 16. Subsequently, the embedding vector passes through a few layers of MLP to match the size of the channel dimension of input image features. Finally, the temporal feature vectors are broadcasted across the H,WH,WH,W dimensions to be added to the image features via residual blocks at each level.

附录 B 病灶检测的统计分析

English original
Appendix: Statistical analysis of pathological detection

病灶检测任务的 Bland-Altman 图见图 13。对各个数据点，我们采用每一类的 mAP50 得分。借助这些图，我们可以检查每种重建方法与全采样数据的一致性。与正文中所作的观察一致，我们看到一致性最好的方法是所提方法，其差值的方差最小。DuDoRNet 与 UNet 的方差都更高，而 TV 与全采样数据差异极大。

English original
Bland-Altman plot of the pathologic detection task is shown in Fig. 13. For individual data points, we resort to the mAP50 score for each class. With the plots, we can check for the agreement of each reconstruction method with the fully sampled data. Consistent with the observations that were made in the main text, we see that the most agreeing method is the proposed method, which shows the least variance in the difference. DuDoRNet and UNet both have higher variance, and TV is radically different from the fully sampled data.
